command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj P8.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: `jmp L1` resolves in place (e9 cb 00 00 00; L1 is 203 bytes after the end of the instruction). `jmp ext` assembles to e9 00 00 00 00 with R_X86_64_PLT32 ext -4; our pcrel_end with addend 0 is the same value.
